meta_reflection.observation: Filings-first order is adequate only if period tags are true. For JSG.L they are not: period_coverage annual=13/interim=3/trading_update=2 counts a FY trading update, Notice of AGM, UKLR 6.4.9R notice and a PDMR as annual, and three NED/AGM/SID items as interim, while the only 2026 operating print (H1 2026 Trading Update, 09c35ef8fa3d6c34) sits as trading_update. yahoo_quarterly_cashflow is on the ladder but empty (TTM suppressed); alternate_news and ir_presentation_metrics are dead steps despite an H2 earnings-call headline. Trading updates are first-class in the index summary but outside the annual/interim assignment rule, so the live HORECA update is easy to drop.

Four worker types plus a five-task cap force annual + interim + news + screen + gap and leave no slot for the FY25 Companies House accounts (ch_00523335_MzUxMzI4MDA2NWFkaXF6a2N4), the 16 Jan 2026 FY trading update, the May AGM/buyback launch, or the weekly Transaction-in-Own-Shares cluster. No task type exists to reconcile filing / TTM / company-adjusted FCF or hire-stock versus PPE capex. Naive first-of-period selection would assign the FY trading update as annual and a NED appointment as interim. summarize_filing_body cannot carry period=annual|interim|trading_update, so the director must smuggle the H1 TU in as the interim body.

The screen still emits strong_buy (8/22, 5/5 families including dividend and FCF Yield) while fcf_basis_overlay is true but fcf_definition_divergence and fcf_divergence_flagged stay false on a 100.6m / ~27.4m split, and snapshot FCF is labelled with a dollar sign on a sterling linen-rental. cyclical_exposure_detected=false and interim_quality_overlay=false despite HORECA softness and empty Yahoo quarterlies; cash_conversion_overlay=false despite OCF 141.8m → 139.9m and investing −103m. failed_models is [] despite 14/22 non-passes. Research overlays already cut to Accumulate / buy, and action_note repeats that paragraph many times, so the trial is asked to re-verify a headline Strong Buy the overlay has already downgraded.

A 6-week persistent strong_buy with an in-flight May 2026 buyback, weekly own-share RNS into 2 Sep, H1 HORECA weakness on 10 July, and no H1 statutory body as of 4 Sep (typical JSG interim window) has no watch schema (H1 2026 results date, remaining buyback authority vs TVR 364.9m, Tweedy Browne 12%, next FY trading update, energy/wage). conviction_score 0.036 versus summary ‘Conviction 80%’ and stability_label=persistent are not substitutes for those monitors.

A generic FINANCIAL REVIEW / RISKS split will blend Workwear with HORECA linen and will not force SEGMENT MIX, FCF-DEFINITION (statutory vs hire-stock-adjusted vs TTM), LEVERAGE/COVENANTS after buybacks, CAPITAL RETURNS (dividend vs cash buybacks vs share cancellation), or an explicit PRIMARY-FILING GAP box for the missing H1 statutory. Without those slots workers will treat TipRanks/Kalkine buyback reprints as colour and Yahoo 100.6m FCF as equivalent to screen TTM 27.4m.

Select the latest dated annual *results* body (FY25 prelim 338b617c814e412b — not CH 2019–2024, not the Jan FY trading update tagged annual, not Notice of AGM) and the latest operating interim/TU (H1 2026 TU 09c35ef8fa3d6c34 — not NED appointments tagged interim). When tagged interims are governance-only, allow the director to assign a trading_update in that slot. Keep gap_inventory mandatory while Yahoo quarterlies and H1 statutory are missing.
